name: com.verateca/verateca
title: Verateca
description: The practical guide to supplements: labels, official upper limits by country, price per day.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the Verateca register by product name, brand, ingredient or barcode. Returns up to 10 matches with IDs, brands, page addresses and recent published prices where available. Use detail "full" for the number of offers and more record details. Results are ordered by match, never by payment. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

query.description: Product name, brand, ingredient or barcode (UPC/EAN).

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one published product by name, ID or page address, or asks which match is meant. The compact answer includes the label composition, applicable reference limits, recent published prices and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for the country status, label verification and detailed comparisons, with age, scope and separate references for other countries. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

id.description: Verateca product id, e.g. "US:302778", as returned by search_products.

url.description: Verateca product page address, as an alternative to id.

product.description: Name on the label, with brand, strength and form where known.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.description: Finds a substance by name, form, synonym or ID. Omega-3 and fish oil identify EPA and DHA separately. Returns forms and the applicable country limit, then other countries’ limits with their scope, sources and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for form details, references and a link to search published products. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

name.description: Substance name, e.g. "Vitamin D", as an alternative to id.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Adds known amounts from up to 12 entries, which can be published product names or IDs or ingredient amounts supplied by the person. Returns matched products, known daily amounts and applicable published adult reference comparisons. Daily totals need an amount, unit and stated daily use. For entries supplied as names or ingredient amounts, the answer can show separate comparisons by adult age. ID-only requests use the lower recorded adult reference when age is unknown. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

product_id.description: Published Verateca product ID. ID-only calls keep the existing label-dose calculation.

servings_per_day.description: Number of servings or doses taken per day, as stated by the person.

product.description: Name on the label, with brand, strength and form where known.

servings_per_day.description: Number of servings or doses taken per day, as stated by the person.

ingredient.description: Ingredient as named on the label.

unit.description: The unit as printed or supplied.

amount_basis.description: What the amount is measured per. When omitted with servings_per_day, the amount is taken per serving or dose.

servings_per_day.description: Number of servings or doses taken per day, as stated by the person.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compares 2 to 6 published products by name or ID and asks for clarification when a match is unclear. The compact answer includes daily amounts, rounded prices and applicable comparisons where available. Use detail "full" for the verified pack basis and detailed reference comparisons. The applicable comparison can vary with age and intake scope. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions. Daily prices are rounded figures as published; they are not a basis for per-milligram or other derived costs.

items.description: Name on the label, with brand, strength and form where known.

products.description: Names of the products to compare.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.

tools.name: get_selection_link
tools.description: Returns the address of the Verateca order page for one of its three paid services (quick, full, review), with the price and currency the site shows for the country and a one-line description. The tool takes no payment and creates no order; the order page asks its own questions and takes payment there.

service.description: quick: up to three products for one goal; full: one set for up to three goals; review: a written review by a Verateca specialist.

goals.description: Optional goals to preselect on the order page (quick: 1, full: up to 3; ignored for review). They travel sealed, not in plain words.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.
